# FileGuard

> Free, secure, ephemeral file and folder sharing platform with pre-flight SHA-256 cryptographic integrity verification, strict 12-hour self-destruct, and zero-knowledge privacy.

## Overview
FileGuard allows users to upload single files, multiple files, or entire folder hierarchies up to 100 MB per transfer without registration or accounts. Files automatically self-destruct after 12 hours from both object storage and database catalogs.

- **Website**: https://files.deeptanil.in
- **Upload Endpoint**: https://files.deeptanil.in/upload
- **User Activity & History**: https://files.deeptanil.in/history
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Deeptanil/FileGuard.git

## Key Capabilities
- **Strict 12-Hour Retention**: Authoritative server-clock deadline ensures zero lingering storage blocks.
- **Pre-Flight Integrity Gate**: Computes live SHA-256 before streaming bytes to clients, halting tampered files with HTTP 409.
- **Dynamic In-Memory Bundling**: Multiple files or entire folder trees are zipped in memory, preserving directory structures.
- **Privacy-First Ephemeral Vault**: Client-side history in localStorage synchronizes live status without server accounts.
- **Anonymous Subnet Quotas**: Fair-use limit of 100 MB per 12 hours per IP subnet (/64 IPv6, /24 IPv4).

## API & Programmatic Usage
- `POST /api/files`: Upload file or bundle (multipart/form-data). Returns token, share_url, expires_at, sha256_reference.
- `GET /api/files/<token>/download`: Download file with SHA-256 pre-flight check.
- `GET /api/files/<token>/status`: Inspect file availability, countdown, and expiration status.
- `POST /api/files/<token>/revoke`: Immediate deletion and revocation by token bearer.
- `POST /api/files/batch-status`: Batch query statuses for up to 50 share tokens.
